Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a big, red ball. One day, she went to the park with her friend, Tim. They wanted to play with the ball.
At the park, Lily and Tim played with the red ball. They laughed and had fun. But then, a big dog came to play with the ball. The dog was naughty and liked to bite things.
The dog bit Lily's ball and she fell down. Lily was sad. Tim saw what happened. He helped Lily stand up and hugged her tight. They played with the ball together and had a great day.

text:
Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a big bin. Lily loved to hug her bin. She liked to hug it so much that it made her feel happy.
One day, Lily's mom had made a delicious snack for her. Lily was so happy! She wanted to hug her bin a lot. But, she saw the bin again. It was dirty and smelly.
Lily's mom told her to give the bin to the people in the town. But Lily didn't want to give it to the town. She wanted her bin. So, she gave it a big hug. The bin became clean and shiny.
Lily was so happy. She hugged her bin and hugged it tight. Now, she could hug her bin and hug it every day. And she knew that she had done a good job.
